mock_response.summary: Dry and bright today with plenty of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 12 or 13 degrees in just light variable breezes, becoming light to moderate east to northeast.
mock_response.text:
Today: Dry and bright today with plenty of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 12 or 13 degrees in just light variable breezes, becoming light to moderate east to northeast.

Tonight: Dry tonight with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 3 to 7 degrees in just light variable or east to northeasterly breezes.

Tomorrow: Tomorrow, Tuesday, will be mostly dry with a mix of cloud and some bright or sunny spells. Soem well scattered showers will push in from the east though. Highest temperatures generally of around 12 degrees in light to moderate northeast to east breezes.

Sun (UV index): Low.
